description: The fixed set of change types applyChanges accepts. Shapes are in `schemas/change.schema.json`.

items.description: Set an input field's value.
Adjust a numeric input field by an amount; tags let incoming-change effects (resistance) modify it first.
Add a copy of a content item to the inventory or features.
Remove a copy, and its picks. May name its copies by query (`copies`) instead of `entry`.
Equip or unequip a copy. May name its copies by query (`copies`) instead of `entry`.

Set a per-copy state value. May name its copies by query (`copies`) instead of `entry`, or applied entries: one by its ID in `entry`, or several by query (`applied`); a pick's state by `path` and `option`, or by query (`picks`); granted content's saved state by `grant` beside its copy or pick, or by query (`grants`).

Adjust a numeric per-copy state value (charges, shots). May name its copies by query (`copies`) instead of `entry`, or applied entries: one by its ID in `entry`, or several by query (`applied`); a pick's state by `path` and `option`, or by query (`picks`); granted content's saved state by `grant` beside its copy or pick, or by query (`grants`).
Set a copy's quantity, not below 0; a copy at 0 stays. May name its copies by query (`copies`) instead of `entry`.
Add to a copy's quantity (spending an arrow); the result may not be below 0, and a copy at 0 stays. May name its copies by query (`copies`) instead of `entry`.
Apply a template to a copy.
Remove a template from a copy.
Start a temporary effect from content the character does not own (Bless). Without `id`, applyChanges picks one from the source.
Remove a temporary effect, by its ID or by query (`applied`).
Turn a temporary effect on or off without removing it, by its ID or by query (`applied`).
Pick an option for a choice. Not on a choice a grant presets (`preset-choice`).

Un-pick an option, removing its nested picks in the same change. Without `option`, every pick of the choice is removed; a choice with none is unchanged. Not on a choice a grant presets (`preset-choice`).
Replace an app's own extension data.
Finish creating the character: clear `creating`. Rejected (`creation-incomplete`) while the character has rules issues or pending choices.
Replace the character's own homebrew, or remove it with `null`. Rejected while the file still uses homebrew it removes.
Dismiss an ephemeral follow-up: delete the stored entry with this ID, without acting on it. Required ones too: `required` is advisory.

Clear an ephemeral follow-up acted on: delete the stored entry with this ID. startAction proposes it when it runs a stored follow-up's action, and a listed follow-up's `changes` end with it. No entry with the ID is no change.
Offer a follow-up the character has: store it as an ephemeral offer once the batch is applied, with the given parameter values. Proposed by actions (a sorcerer's blood magic after a cast).
